run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit completed across all four namespaces whose names start with 'app-283': app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search. A ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' exists in every one of them, and each carries an 'audit_code' key (alongside 'owner' and 'tier'). The observed values are: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q, app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V, app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z, app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. No namespace in the 13 namespaces present in the cluster starts with 'app-283' other than these four. These are the objects' state at the moment of the query (observed 2026-11-21T03:36:24Z), not a historical record of the authorized window.

claims.text: Exactly four namespaces whose names start with 'app-283' were returned by the cluster: app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search (result_count 4 of 13 total namespace items processed).

No namespace-name discovery beyond the 13 namespace objects present at query time was possible, so namespaces that existed earlier and were deleted would not appear.
next_steps: If a point-in-time audit code for a past timestamp is required, obtain it from a configuration change-history source, which was not available in this Run.
Optionally cross-check the 'owner' and 'tier' keys of each service-manifest ConfigMap against the owning team/tier records, since they were present but were not part of the requested audit field.
